DRAGON

One undirected partial-correlation network within and between two matched omics layers (any two, e.g. expression and methylation), across all samples. A p-value and a Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value for every edge (adjusted within each layer and across the layers), to filter edges by significance. Cross-layer edges compared between groups.
Our paired proteomics and phosphoproteomics tables from the same 48 ovarian tumours should go through DRAGON.
LIONESS-DRAGON
One two-layer partial-correlation network per sample, plus the aggregate. Per-sample edges compared between groups or individuals.
